description: Users in a web browser (single-page app or server-rendered site). Sends its share of the workload over a broadband network and does not retry by default.
modeled: Open-loop arrivals: clients do not slow down when the system is slow
Per-attempt client timeout and bounded retries with exponential backoff
Its share of the workload, split from the same arrivals as the other client groups
Home or office network delay as the latency of its link (default p50 15 ms / p95 45 ms one way)
notModeled: Static assets, browser caching and CDN hits (model a CDN as a cache in front if needed)
